children: , the global payments network, faced pressure from major banks demanding tougher safeguards for AI shopping agents as fraud, scams and data-privacy risks move into focus. Shares rose roughly 0.9% to $564.98 at 10.47am ET time on Thursday morning.

Mastercard is already pushing deeper into agentic commerce through Agent Connect, which brings merchants, AI platforms and payment providers together through a single integration. Its merchant tools can combine Anthropic's commerce-agent blueprint with Mastercard's payment intelligence and authorization controls. The pitch is simple: let AI shop for consumers while keeping Mastercard at the center of every transaction.

That opportunity comes with sharp edges. Shopping bots could drive more payment volume, but misunderstood instructions, disputed purchases and murky liability could also inflate network costs. At $564.98, Mastercard trades 17.49% below its GF Value of $684.73, signaling meaningful upside if the company can make AI-driven payments convenient without making authorization less trustworthy.

title: Mastercard Gains as Banks Challenge Agentic-Commerce Guardrails
